BiblicalUsage: Chacpac is a shred, a flake, a small round thing — the manna lying on the face of the wilderness like a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds His people with flakes, not feasts, because daily bread teaches daily trust.
RelatedEvents: Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
